SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   C. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   B. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   D. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

6. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   C. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.
   C. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   B. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   D. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

10. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   C. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
